reviewer_note: design-reviewer subagent ran read-only (no Write tool); findings persisted verbatim by conductor

findings.detail: Web tab WIs depend_on only [WI-13, their API WI], not on each other, but each lists web/src/shared/api/client.ts + cs.json + en.json in files_touched. Parallel execution collides on those shared files (merge conflicts + locales.parity race) — the exact hazard the api chain (WI-06..10 schedule_note) serializes against, applied only to lane api. Chain the web tab WIs or add an explicit serialize-on-shared-files contract.

The <500ms@50k perf test does not state it runs compare=true. compare recomputes the full aggregate for the immediately-preceding equal-length period (~2x query cost). AC#3's budget is untested on the doubled path the feature ships. Require the 50k perf test to exercise the compare branch (or add a second measured case).

ZoneService supports BOTH Circle (center+radius) and Polygon zones. WI-02/WI-05 describe bbox derivation only as 'min/max lat/lng' (polygon-style). Circle zones need bbox = center ± radius-in-degrees; without that, circle-zone pickups are unattributed or mis-bounded. WI-05 must specify Circle-zone bbox derivation, not just polygon min/max.

IPushSender.SendAsync returns Task<PushSendResult> and takes a PushMessage (verified at Infrastructure/Notifications/IPushSender.cs); on HTTP 410 Gone it deletes the subscription and reports PushSendOutcome.Gone. WI-10 says 'send Web Push via IPushSender' but does not state handling of the Gone/failed outcome per recipient (log + continue, do not let one dead subscription abort the fleet's digest or block the idempotency-marker insert). Add a deliverable/test for per-recipient outcome handling.

percentile_cont over EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (assigned_at - created_at)) must exclude rows where the later timestamp is NULL (unassigned/uncancelled orders), else NULL epochs skew or break the percentile. WI-02 spike ACs list the shape but not the NULL-filtering contract; WI-06 SLA series inherits the gap. State that each SLA metric filters to rows where both endpoints of the interval are non-null before percentile_cont.

WI-12 sets the dist/assets/analytics-*.js size-limit budget and runs npm run size BEFORE any analytics chunk content exists (chunk is near-empty at WI-12). Each later tab grows the chunk with no re-check against a real budget. Add a size re-validation/adjustment step at WI-13 (first real content) and note tab WIs re-run npm run size.

Inconsistency between designer artifacts: handoff-designer.json assumption #2 says top-customer masking uses 'a new shared maskCustomerIdentity util', but the work-items doc assumption #2 + WI-15 masking_decision_note say NO masking (verified: board OrderCard.tsx shows customerPhone/customerName unmasked; no mask util exists). The WI doc (authoritative for the developer) is correct; the handoff JSON is stale/contradictory. Reconcile the handoff JSON to the unmasked decision so conductor state is not misleading.

Verified WI-01's index-dedup claim against OrderConfiguration.cs: (fleet_id, status, created_at) and (fleet_id, driver_id, created_at) already exist and WI-01 correctly does NOT re-add them. New composite indexes and DbSet<WeeklyDigestMarker> registration are correctly scoped. No change needed — recorded for traceability.
